1.zh: 奉　神旨意，蒙召作耶稣基督使徒的保罗，同兄弟所提尼，
1.en: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

1.zh: 写信给在哥林多　神的教会，就是在基督耶稣里成圣、蒙召作圣徒的，以及所有在各处求告我主耶稣基督之名的人。基督是他们的[主]，也是我们的[主]。
1.en: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

1.zh: 愿恩惠、平安从　神我们的父并主耶稣基督归与你们。
1.en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 我常为你们感谢我的　神，因　神在基督耶稣里所赐给你们的恩惠；
1.en: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

1.zh: 又因你们在他里面凡事富足，口才、知识都全备，
1.en: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

1.zh: 正如[我为]基督[作]的见证，在你们心里得以坚固，
1.en: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

1.zh: 以致你们在恩赐上没有一样不及人的，等候我们的主耶稣基督显现。
1.en: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

1.zh: 他也必坚固你们到底，叫你们在我们主耶稣基督的日子无可责备。
1.en: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

1.zh: 神是信实的，你们原是被他所召，好与他儿子—我们的主耶稣基督一同得分。
1.en: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

1.zh: 弟兄们，我借我们主耶稣基督的名劝你们都说一样的话。你们中间也不可分党，只要一心一意，彼此相合。
1.en: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

1.zh: 因为革来氏[家里]的人曾对我提起弟兄们来，说你们中间有纷争。
1.en: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

1.zh: 我的意思就是你们各人说：「我是属保罗的」；「我是属亚波罗的」；「我是属矶法的」；「我是属基督的」。
1.en: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

1.zh: 基督是分开的吗？保罗为你们钉了十字架吗？你们是奉保罗的名受了洗吗？
1.en: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

1.zh: 我感谢　神，除了基利司布并该犹以外，我没有给你们一个人施洗，
1.en: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

1.zh: 免得有人说，你们是奉我的名受洗。
1.en: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

1.zh: 我也给司提反家施过洗，此外给别人施洗没有，我却记不清。
1.en: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

1.zh: 基督差遣我，原不是为施洗，乃是为传福音，并不用智慧的言语，免得基督的十字架落了空。
1.en: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

1.zh: 因为十字架的道理，在那灭亡的人为愚拙；在我们得救的人，却为　神的大能。
1.en: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

1.zh: 就如[经上]所记： 我要灭绝智慧人的智慧， 废弃聪明人的聪明。
1.en: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”

1.zh: 智慧人在哪里？文士在哪里？这世上的辩士在哪里？　神岂不是叫这世上的智慧变成愚拙吗？
1.en: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

1.zh: 世人凭自己的智慧，既不认识　神，　神就乐意用[人所当作]愚拙的道理拯救那些信的人；这就是　神的智慧了。
1.en: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

1.zh: 犹太人是要神迹，希腊人是求智慧，
1.en: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

1.zh: 我们却是传钉在十字架的基督，在犹太人为绊脚石，在外邦人为愚拙；
1.en: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

1.zh: 但在那蒙召的，无论是犹太人、希腊人，基督总为　神的能力，　神的智慧。
1.en: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

1.zh: 因　神的愚拙总比人智慧，　神的软弱总比人强壮。
1.en: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

1.zh: 弟兄们哪，可见你们蒙召的，按着肉体有智慧的不多，有能力的不多，有尊贵的也不多。
1.en: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

1.zh: 神却拣选了世上愚拙的，叫有智慧的羞愧；又拣选了世上软弱的，叫那强壮的羞愧。
1.en: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

1.zh: 神也拣选了世上卑贱的，被人厌恶的，以及那无有的，为要废掉那有的，
1.en: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

1.zh: 使一切有血气的，在　神面前一个也不能自夸。
1.en: that no flesh should boast before God.

1.zh: 但你们得在基督耶稣里是本乎　神，　神又使他成为我们的智慧、公义、圣洁、救赎。
1.en: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

1.zh: 如[经上]所记：「夸口的，当指着主夸口。」
1.en: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

2.zh: 弟兄们，从前我到你们那里去，并没有用高言大智对你们宣传　神的奥秘。
2.en: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

2.zh: 因为我曾定了主意，在你们中间不知道别的，只知道耶稣基督并他钉十字架。
2.en: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

2.zh: 我在你们那里，又软弱，又惧怕又甚战兢。
2.en: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

2.zh: 我说的话、讲的道，不是用智慧委婉的言语，乃是用圣灵和大能的明证，
2.en: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

2.zh: 叫你们的信不在乎人的智慧，只在乎　神的大能。
2.en: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

2.zh: 然而，在完全的人中，我们也讲智慧。但不是这世上的智慧，也不是这世上有权有位、将要败亡之人的智慧。
2.en: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

2.zh: 我们讲的，乃是从前所隐藏、　神奥秘的智慧，就是　神在万世以前预定使我们得荣耀的。
2.en: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

2.zh: 这智慧世上有权有位的人没有一个知道的，他们若知道，就不把荣耀的主钉在十字架上了。
2.en: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

2.zh: 如[经上]所记： 　神为爱他的人所预备的 是眼睛未曾看见， 耳朵未曾听见， 人心也未曾想到的。
2.en: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

2.zh: 只有　神借着圣灵向我们显明了，因为圣灵参透万事，就是　神深奥的事也参透了。
2.en: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

2.zh: 除了在人里头的灵，谁知道人的事？像这样，除了　神的灵，也没有人知道　神的事。
2.en: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

2.zh: 我们所领受的，并不是世上的灵，乃是从　神来的灵，叫我们能知道　神开恩赐给我们的事。
2.en: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

2.zh: 并且我们讲说这些事，不是用人智慧所指教的言语，乃是用[圣]灵所指教的言语，将属灵的话解释属灵的事。
2.en: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

2.zh: 然而，属血气的人不领会　神[圣]灵的事，反倒以为愚拙，并且不能知道，因为这些事惟有属灵的人才能看透。
2.en: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

2.zh: 属灵的人能看透万事，却没有一人能看透了他。
2.en: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

2.zh: 谁曾知道主的心去教导他呢？但我们是有基督的心了。
2.en: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

3.zh: 弟兄们，我从前对你们说话，不能把你们当作属灵的，只得把你们当作属肉体，在基督里为婴孩的。
3.en: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

3.zh: 我是用奶喂你们，没有用饭喂你们。那时你们不能吃，就是如今还是不能。
3.en: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

3.zh: 你们仍是属肉体的，因为在你们中间有嫉妒、纷争，这岂不是属乎肉体、照着世人的样子行吗？
3.en: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

3.zh: 有说：「我是属保罗的」；有说：「我是属亚波罗的。」这岂不是你们和世人一样吗？
3.en: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

3.zh: 亚波罗算什么？保罗算什么？无非是执事，照主所赐给他们各人的，引导你们相信。
3.en: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

3.zh: 我栽种了，亚波罗浇灌了，惟有　神叫他生长。
3.en: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

3.zh: 可见栽种的，算不得什么，浇灌的，也算不得什么；只在那叫他生长的　神。
3.en: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

3.zh: 栽种的和浇灌的，都是一样，但将来各人要照自己的工夫得自己的赏赐。
3.en: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

3.zh: 因为我们是与　神同工的；你们是　神所耕种的田地，所建造的房屋。
3.en: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

3.zh: 我照　神所给我的恩，好像一个聪明的工头，立好了根基，有别人在上面建造；只是各人要谨慎怎样在上面建造。
3.en: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

3.zh: 因为那已经立好的根基就是耶稣基督，此外没有人能立别的根基。
3.en: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

3.zh: 若有人用金、银、宝石、草木、禾秸在这根基上建造，
3.en: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

3.zh: 各人的工程必然显露，因为那日子要将它表明出来，有火发现；这火要试验各人的工程怎样。
3.en: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

3.zh: 人在那根基上所建造的工程若存得住，他就要得赏赐。
3.en: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

3.zh: 人的工程若被烧了，他就要受亏损，自己却要得救；虽然得救，乃像从火里经过的一样。
3.en: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

3.zh: 岂不知你们是　神的殿，　神的灵住在你们里头吗？
3.en: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

3.zh: 若有人毁坏　神的殿，　神必要毁坏那人；因为　神的殿是圣的，这殿就是你们。
3.en: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

3.zh: 人不可自欺。你们中间若有人在这世界自以为有智慧，倒不如变作愚拙，好成为有智慧的。
3.en: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

3.zh: 因这世界的智慧，在　神看是愚拙。如[经上]记着说：「主叫有智慧的，中了自己的诡计」；
3.en: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

3.zh: 又说：「主知道智慧人的意念是虚妄的。」
3.en: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”

3.zh: 所以无论谁，都不可拿人夸口，因为万有全是你们的。
3.en: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

3.zh: 或保罗，或亚波罗，或矶法，或世界，或生，或死，或现今的事，或将来的事，全是你们的；
3.en: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

3.zh: 并且你们是属基督的，基督又是属　神的。
3.en: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

4.zh: 人应当以我们为基督的执事，为　神奥秘事的管家。
4.en: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

4.zh: 所求于管家的，是要他有忠心。
4.en: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

4.zh: 我被你们论断，或被别人论断，我都以为极小的事；连我自己也不论断自己。
4.en: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

4.zh: 我虽不觉得自己有错，却也不能因此得以称义；但判断我的乃是主。
4.en: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

4.zh: 所以，时候未到，什么都不要论断，只等主来，他要照出暗中的隐情，显明人心的意念。那时，各人要从　神那里得着称赞。
4.en: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

4.zh: 弟兄们，我为你们的缘故，拿这些事转比自己和亚波罗，叫你们效法我们不可过于[圣经]所记，免得你们自高自大，贵重这个，轻看那个。
4.en: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

4.zh: 使你与人不同的是谁呢？你有什么不是领受的呢？若是领受的，为何自夸，仿佛不是领受的呢？
4.en: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

4.zh: 你们已经饱足了！已经丰富了！不用我们，自己就作王了！我愿意你们果真作王，叫我们也得与你们一同作王。
4.en: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

4.zh: 我想　神把我们使徒明明列在末后，好像定死罪的囚犯；因为我们成了一台戏，给世人和天使观看。
4.en: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

4.zh: 我们为基督的缘故算是愚拙的，你们在基督里倒是聪明的；我们软弱，你们倒强壮；你们有荣耀，我们倒被藐视。
4.en: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

4.zh: 直到如今，我们还是又饥又渴，又赤身露体，又挨打，又没有一定的住处，
4.en: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

4.zh: 并且劳苦，亲手做工。被人咒骂，我们就祝福；被人逼迫，我们就忍受；
4.en: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

4.zh: 被人毁谤，我们就善劝。直到如今，人还把我们看作世界上的污秽，万物中的渣滓。
4.en: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

4.zh: 我写这话，不是叫你们羞愧，乃是警戒你们，好像我所亲爱的儿女一样。
4.en: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

4.zh: 你们学基督的，师傅虽有一万，为父的却是不多，因我在基督耶稣里用福音生了你们。
4.en: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

4.zh: 所以，我求你们效法我。
4.en: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

4.zh: 因此我已打发提摩太到你们那里去。他在主里面，是我所亲爱、有忠心的儿子。他必提醒你们，记念我在基督里怎样行事，在各处各教会中怎样教导人。
4.en: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

4.zh: 有些人自高自大，以为我不到你们那里去；
4.en: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

4.zh: 然而，主若许我，我必快到你们那里去，并且我所要知道的，不是那些自高自大之人的言语，乃是他们的权能。
4.en: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

4.zh: 因为　神的国不在乎言语，乃在乎权能。
4.en: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

4.zh: 你们愿意怎么样呢？是愿意我带着刑杖到你们那里去呢？还是要我存慈爱温柔的心呢？
4.en: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

5.zh: 风闻在你们中间有淫乱的事。这样的淫乱连外邦人中也没有，就是有人收了他的继母。
5.en: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

5.zh: 你们还是自高自大，并不哀痛，把行这事的人从你们中间赶出去。
5.en: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

5.zh: 我身子虽不在你们那里，心却在你们那里，好像我亲自与你们同在，已经判断了行这事的人。
5.en: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

5.zh: 就是你们聚会的时候，我的心也同在。奉我们主耶稣的名，并用我们主耶稣的权能，
5.en: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

5.zh: 要把这样的人交给撒但，败坏他的肉体，使他的灵魂在主耶稣的日子可以得救。
5.en: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

5.zh: 你们这自夸是不好的。岂不知一点面酵能使全团发起来吗？
5.en: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

5.zh: 你们既是无酵的面，应当把旧酵除净，好使你们成为新团；因为我们逾越节的[羔羊]基督已经被杀献祭了。
5.en: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

5.zh: 所以，我们守这节不可用旧酵，也不可用恶毒、邪恶的酵，只用诚实真正的无酵饼。
5.en: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

5.zh: 我先前写信给你们说，不可与淫乱的人相交。
5.en: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

5.zh: 此话不是指这世上一概行淫乱的，或贪婪的，勒索的，或拜偶像的；若是这样，你们除非离开世界方可。
5.en: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

5.zh: 但如今我写信给你们说，若有称为弟兄是行淫乱的，或贪婪的，或拜偶像的，或辱骂的，或醉酒的，或勒索的，这样的人不可与他相交，就是与他吃饭都不可。
5.en: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

5.zh: 因为审判[教]外的人与我何干？[教]内的人岂不是你们审判的吗？
5.en: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

5.zh: 至于外人有　神审判他们。你们应当把那恶人从你们中间赶出去。
5.en: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”

6.zh: 你们中间有彼此相争的事，怎敢在不义的人面前求审，不在圣徒面前求审呢？
6.en: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

6.zh: 岂不知圣徒要审判世界吗？若世界为你们所审，难道你们不配审判这最小的事吗？
6.en: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

6.zh: 岂不知我们要审判天使吗？何况今生的事呢？
6.en: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

6.zh: 既是这样，你们若有今生的事当审判，是派教会所轻看的人审判吗？
6.en: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

6.zh: 我说这话是要叫你们羞耻。难道你们中间没有一个智慧人能审断弟兄们的事吗？
6.en: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

6.zh: 你们竟是弟兄与弟兄告状，而且告在不信[主]的人面前。
6.en: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

6.zh: 你们彼此告状，这已经是你们的大错了。为什么不情愿受欺呢？为什么不情愿吃亏呢？
6.en: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

6.zh: 你们倒是欺压人、亏负人，况且所欺压所亏负的就是弟兄。
6.en: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

6.zh: 你们岂不知不义的人不能承受　神的国吗？不要自欺！无论是淫乱的、拜偶像的、奸淫的、作娈童的、亲男色的、
6.en: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

6.zh: 偷窃的、贪婪的、醉酒的、辱骂的、勒索的，都不能承受　神的国。
6.en: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

6.zh: 你们中间也有人从前是这样；但如今你们奉主耶稣基督的名，并借着我们　神的灵，已经洗净，成圣，称义了。
6.en: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

6.zh: 凡事我都可行，但不都有益处。凡事我都可行，但无论哪一件，我总不受它的辖制。
6.en: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

6.zh: 食物是为肚腹，肚腹是为食物；但　神要叫这两样都废坏。身子不是为淫乱，乃是为主；主也是为身子。
6.en: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

6.zh: 并且　神已经叫主复活，也要用自己的能力叫我们复活。
6.en: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

6.zh: 岂不知你们的身子是基督的肢体吗？我可以将基督的肢体作为娼妓的肢体吗？断乎不可！
6.en: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

6.zh: 岂不知与娼妓联合的，便是与她成为一体吗？因为主说：「二人要成为一体。」
6.en: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”

6.zh: 但与主联合的，便是与主成为一灵。
6.en: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

6.zh: 你们要逃避淫行。人所犯的，无论什么罪，都在身子以外，惟有行淫的，是得罪自己的身子。
6.en: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

6.zh: 岂不知你们的身子就是圣灵的殿吗？这圣灵是从　神而来，住在你们里头的；并且你们不是自己的人，
6.en: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

6.zh: 因为你们是重价买来的。所以，要在你们的身子上荣耀　神。
6.en: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

7.zh: 论到你们信上所提的事，[我说]男不近女倒好。
7.en: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

7.zh: 但要免淫乱的事，男子当各有自己的妻子；女子也当各有自己的丈夫。
7.en: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

7.zh: 丈夫当用合宜之分待妻子；妻子待丈夫也要如此。
7.en: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

7.zh: 妻子没有权柄主张自己的身子，乃在丈夫；丈夫也没有权柄主张自己的身子，乃在妻子。
7.en: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

7.zh: 夫妻不可彼此亏负，除非两相情愿，暂时分房，为要专心祷告方可；以后仍要同房，免得撒但趁着你们情不自禁，引诱你们。
7.en: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

7.zh: 我说这话，原是准[你们]的，不是命[你们]的。
7.en: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

7.zh: 我愿意众人像我一样；只是各人领受　神的恩赐，一个是这样，一个是那样。
7.en: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

7.zh: 我对着没有嫁娶的和寡妇说，若他们常像我就好。
7.en: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

7.zh: 倘若自己禁止不住，就可以嫁娶。与其欲火攻心，倒不如嫁娶为妙。
7.en: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

7.zh: 至于那已经嫁娶的，我吩咐他们；其实不是我吩咐，乃是主吩咐说：妻子不可离开丈夫，
7.en: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

7.zh: 若是离开了，不可再嫁，或是仍同丈夫和好。丈夫也不可离弃妻子。
7.en: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

7.zh: 我对其余的人说（不是主说）：倘若某弟兄有不信的妻子，妻子也情愿和他同住，他就不要离弃妻子。
7.en: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

7.zh: 妻子有不信的丈夫，丈夫也情愿和她同住，她就不要离弃丈夫。
7.en: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

7.zh: 因为不信的丈夫就因着妻子成了圣洁，并且不信的妻子就因着丈夫成了圣洁。不然，你们的儿女就不洁净，但如今他们是圣洁的了。
7.en: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

7.zh: 倘若那不信的人要离去，就由他离去吧！无论是弟兄，是姊妹，遇着这样的事都不必拘束。　神召我们原是要我们和睦。
7.en: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

7.zh: 你这作妻子的，怎么知道不能救你的丈夫呢？你这作丈夫的，怎么知道不能救你的妻子呢？
7.en: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

7.zh: 只要照主所分给各人的，和　神所召各人的而行。我吩咐各教会都是这样。
7.en: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

7.zh: 有人已受割礼蒙召呢，就不要废割礼；有人未受割礼蒙召呢，就不要受割礼。
7.en: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

7.zh: 受割礼算不得什么，不受割礼也算不得什么，只要守　神的诫命就是了。
7.en: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

7.zh: 各人蒙召的时候是什么身分，仍要守住这身分。
7.en: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

7.zh: 你是作奴隶蒙召的吗？不要因此忧虑；若能以自由，就求自由更好。
7.en: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

7.zh: 因为作奴仆蒙召于主的，就是主所释放的人；作自由之人蒙召的，就是基督的奴仆。
7.en: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

7.zh: 你们是重价买来的，不要作人的奴仆。
7.en: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

7.zh: 弟兄们，你们各人蒙召的时候是什么身分，仍要在　神面前守住这身分。
7.en: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

7.zh: 论到童身的人，我没有主的命令，但我既蒙主怜恤能作忠心的人，就把自己的意见告诉[你们]。
7.en: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

7.zh: 因现今的艰难，据我看来，人不如守素安常才好。
7.en: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

7.zh: 你有妻子缠着呢，就不要求脱离；你没有妻子缠着呢，就不要求妻子。
7.en: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

7.zh: 你若娶妻，并不是犯罪；处女若出嫁，也不是犯罪。然而这等人肉身必受苦难，我却愿意你们免这苦难。
7.en: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

7.zh: 弟兄们，我对你们说：时候减少了。从此以后，那有妻子的，要像没有妻子；
7.en: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

7.zh: 哀哭的，要像不哀哭；快乐的，要像不快乐；置买的，要像无有所得；
7.en: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

7.zh: 用世物的，要像不用世物，因为这世界的样子将要过去了。
7.en: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

7.zh: 我愿你们无所挂虑。没有娶妻的，是为主的事挂虑，想怎样叫主喜悦。
7.en: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

7.zh: 娶了妻的，是为世上的事挂虑，想怎样叫妻子喜悦。
7.en: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

7.zh: 妇人和处女也有分别。没有出嫁的，是为主的事挂虑，要身体、灵魂都圣洁；已经出嫁的，是为世上的事挂虑，想怎样叫丈夫喜悦。
7.en: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

7.zh: 我说这话是为你们的益处，不是要牢笼你们，乃是要叫你们行合宜的事，得以殷勤服事主，没有分心的事。
7.en: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

7.zh: 若有人以为自己待他的女儿不合宜，女儿也过了年岁，事又当行，他就可随意办理，不算有罪，叫二人成亲就是了。
7.en: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

7.zh: 倘若人心里坚定，没有不得已的事，并且由得自己作主，心里又决定了留下女儿[不出嫁]，如此行也好。
7.en: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

7.zh: 这样看来，叫自己的女儿出嫁是好，不叫她出嫁更是好。
7.en: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

7.zh: 丈夫活着的时候，妻子是被约束的；丈夫若死了，妻子就可以自由，随意再嫁，只是要嫁这在主里面的人。
7.en: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

7.zh: 然而按我的意见，若常守节更有福气。我也想自己是被　神的灵感动了。
7.en: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

8.zh: 论到祭偶像之物，我们晓得我们都有知识。但知识是叫人自高自大，惟有爱心能造就人。
8.en: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

8.zh: 若有人以为自己知道什么，按他所当知道的，他仍是不知道。
8.en: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

8.zh: 若有人爱　神，这人乃是　神所知道的。
8.en: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

8.zh: 论到吃祭偶像之物，我们知道偶像在世上算不得什么，也知道　神只有一位，再没有别的　神。
8.en: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

8.zh: 虽有称为神的，或在天，或在地，就如那许多的神，许多的主；
8.en: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

8.zh: 然而我们只有一位　神，就是父—万物都本于他；我们也归于他—并有一位主，就是耶稣基督—万物都是借着他有的；我们也是借着他有的。
8.en: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

8.zh: 但人不都有这等知识。有人到如今因拜惯了偶像，就以为所吃的是祭偶像之物。他们的良心既然软弱，也就污秽了。
8.en: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

8.zh: 其实食物不能叫　神看中我们，因为我们不吃也无损，吃也无益。
8.en: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

8.zh: 只是你们要谨慎，恐怕你们这自由竟成了那软弱人的绊脚石。
8.en: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

8.zh: 若有人见你这有知识的，在偶像的庙里坐席，这人的良心若是软弱，岂不放胆去吃那祭偶像之物吗？
8.en: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

8.zh: 因此，基督为他死的那软弱弟兄，也就因你的知识沉沦了。
8.en: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

8.zh: 你们这样得罪弟兄们，伤了他们软弱的良心，就是得罪基督。
8.en: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

8.zh: 所以，食物若叫我弟兄跌倒，我就永远不吃肉，免得叫我弟兄跌倒了。
8.en: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

9.zh: 我不是自由的吗？我不是使徒吗？我不是见过我们的主耶稣吗？你们不是我在主里面所做之工吗？
9.en: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

9.zh: 假若在别人，我不是使徒，在你们，我总是使徒，因为你们在主里正是我作使徒的印证。
9.en: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

9.zh: 我对那盘问我的人就是这样分诉：
9.en: My defense to those who examine me is this:

9.zh: 难道我们没有权柄[靠福音]吃喝吗？
9.en: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

9.zh: 难道我们没有权柄娶[信主的]姊妹为妻，带着一同往来，仿佛其余的使徒和主的弟兄并矶法一样吗？
9.en: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

9.zh: 独有我与巴拿巴没有权柄不做工吗？
9.en: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

9.zh: 有谁当兵自备粮饷呢？有谁栽葡萄园不吃园里的果子呢？有谁牧养牛羊不吃牛羊的奶呢？
9.en: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

9.zh: 我说这话，岂是照人的意见；律法不也是这样说吗？
9.en: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

9.zh: 就如摩西的律法记着说：「牛[在场上]踹谷的时候，不可笼住它的嘴。」难道　神所挂念的是牛吗？
9.en: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

9.zh: 不全是为我们说的吗？分明是为我们说的。因为耕种的当存着指望去耕种；打场的也当存得[粮]的指望去打场。
9.en: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

9.zh: 我们若把属灵的种子撒在你们中间，就是从你们收割奉养肉身之物，这还算大事吗？
9.en: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

9.zh: 若别人在你们身上有这权柄，何况我们呢？ 然而，我们没有用过这权柄，倒凡事忍受，免得基督的福音被阻隔。
9.en: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

9.zh: 你们岂不知为圣事劳碌的就吃殿中的物吗？伺候祭坛的就分领坛上的物吗？
9.en: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

9.zh: 主也是这样命定，叫传福音的靠着福音养生。
9.en: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

9.zh: 但这权柄我全没有用过。我写这话，并非要你们这样待我，因为我宁可死也不叫人使我所夸的落了空。
9.en: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

9.zh: 我传福音原没有可夸的，因为我是不得已的。若不传福音，我便有祸了。
9.en: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

9.zh: 我若甘心做这事，就有赏赐；若不甘心，责任却已经托付我了。
9.en: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

9.zh: 既是这样，我的赏赐是什么呢？就是我传福音的时候叫人不花钱得福音，免得用尽我传福音的权柄。
9.en: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

9.zh: 我虽是自由的，无人辖管；然而我甘心作了众人的仆人，为要多得人。
9.en: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

9.zh: 向犹太人，我就作犹太人，为要得犹太人；向律法以下的人，我虽不在律法以下，还是作律法以下的人，为要得律法以下的人。
9.en: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

9.zh: 向没有律法的人，我就作没有律法的人，为要得没有律法的人；其实我在　神面前，不是没有律法；在基督面前，正在律法之下。
9.en: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

9.zh: 向软弱的人，我就作软弱的人，为要得软弱的人。向什么样的人，我就作什么样的人。无论如何，总要救些人。
9.en: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

9.zh: 凡我所行的，都是为福音的缘故，为要与人同得这福音[的好处]。
9.en: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

9.zh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。
9.en: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

9.zh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。
9.en: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

9.zh: 所以，我奔跑不像无定向的；我斗拳不像打空气的。
9.en: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

9.zh: 我是攻克己身，叫身服我，恐怕我传[福音]给别人，自己反被弃绝了。
9.en: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

10.zh: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不晓得，我们的祖宗从前都在云下，都从海中经过，
10.en: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

10.zh: 都在云里、海里受洗归了摩西；
10.en: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

10.zh: 并且都吃了一样的灵食，
10.en: and all ate the same spiritual food;

10.zh: 也都喝了一样的灵水。所喝的，是出于随着他们的灵磐石；那磐石就是基督。
10.en: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

10.zh: 但他们中间多半是　神不喜欢的人，所以在旷野倒毙。
10.en: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

10.zh: 这些事都是我们的鉴戒，叫我们不要贪恋恶事，像他们那样贪恋的；
10.en: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

10.zh: 也不要拜偶像，像他们有人拜的。如[经上]所记：「百姓坐下吃喝，起来玩耍。」
10.en: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

10.zh: 我们也不要行奸淫，像他们有人行的，一天就倒毙了二万三千人；
10.en: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

10.zh: 也不要试探主，像他们有人试探的，就被蛇所灭。
10.en: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

10.zh: 你们也不要发怨言，像他们有发怨言的，就被灭命的所灭。
10.en: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

10.zh: 他们遭遇这些事都要作为鉴戒，并且写[在经上]，正是警戒我们这末世的人。
10.en: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

10.zh: 所以，自己以为站得稳的，须要谨慎，免得跌倒。
10.en: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

10.zh: 你们所遇见的试探，无非是人所能受的。　神是信实的，必不叫你们受试探过于所能受的；在受试探的时候，总要给你们开一条出路，叫你们能忍受得住。
10.en: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

10.zh: 我所亲爱的[弟兄]啊，你们要逃避拜偶像的事。
10.en: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

10.zh: 我好像对明白人说的，你们要审察我的话。
10.en: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

10.zh: 我们所祝福的杯，岂不是同领基督的血吗？我们所擘开的饼，岂不是同领基督的身体吗？
10.en: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

10.zh: 我们虽多，仍是一个饼，一个身体，因为我们都是分受这一个饼。
10.en: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

10.zh: 你们看属肉体的以色列人，那吃祭物的岂不是在祭坛上有分吗？
10.en: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

10.zh: 我是怎么说呢？岂是说祭偶像之物算得什么呢？或说偶像算得什么呢？
10.en: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

10.zh: 我乃是说，外邦人所献的祭是祭鬼，不是祭　神。我不愿意你们与鬼相交。
10.en: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

10.zh: 你们不能喝主的杯又喝鬼的杯，不能吃主的筵席又吃鬼的筵席。
10.en: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

10.zh: 我们可惹主的愤恨吗？我们比他还有能力吗？
10.en: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

10.zh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处。凡事都可行，但不都造就人。
10.en: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

10.zh: 无论何人，不要求自己的益处，乃要求别人的益处。
10.en: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

10.zh: 凡市上所卖的，你们只管吃，不要为良心的缘故问什么话，
10.en: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

10.zh: 因为地和其中所充满的都属乎主。
10.en: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

10.zh: 倘有一个不信的人请你们[赴席]，你们若愿意去，凡摆在你们面前的，只管吃，不要为良心的缘故问什么话。
10.en: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

10.zh: 若有人对你们说：「这是献过祭的物」，就要为那告诉你们的人，并为良心的缘故不吃。
10.en: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

10.zh: 我说的良心不是你的，乃是他的。我这自由为什么被别人的良心论断呢？
10.en: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

10.zh: 我若谢恩而吃，为什么因我谢恩的物被人毁谤呢？
10.en: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

10.zh: 所以，你们或吃或喝，无论做什么，都要为荣耀　神而行。
10.en: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

10.zh: 不拘是犹太人，是希腊人，是　神的教会，你们都不要使他跌倒；
10.en: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

10.zh: 就好像我凡事都叫众人喜欢，不求自己的益处，只求众人的益处，叫他们得救。
10.en: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

11.zh: 你们该效法我，像我效法基督一样。
11.en: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

11.zh: 我称赞你们，因你们凡事记念我，又坚守我所传给你们的。
11.en: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

11.zh: 我愿意你们知道，基督是各人的头；男人是女人的头；　神是基督的头。
11.en: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

11.zh: 凡男人祷告或是讲道，若蒙着头，就羞辱自己的头。
11.en: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

11.zh: 凡女人祷告或是讲道，若不蒙着头，就羞辱自己的头，因为这就如同剃了头发一样。
11.en: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

11.zh: 女人若不蒙着头，就该剪了头发；女人若以剪发、剃发为羞愧，就该蒙着头。
11.en: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

11.zh: 男人本不该蒙着头，因为他是　神的形象和荣耀；但女人是男人的荣耀。
11.en: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

11.zh: 起初，男人不是由女人而出，女人乃是由男人而出；
11.en: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

11.zh: 并且男人不是为女人造的，女人乃是为男人造的。
11.en: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

11.zh: 因此，女人为天使的缘故，应当在头上有服权柄的[记号]。
11.en: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

11.zh: 然而照主的安排，女也不是无男，男也不是无女。
11.en: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

11.zh: 因为女人原是由男人而出，男人也是由女人而出；但万有都是出乎　神。
11.en: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

11.zh: 你们自己审察，女人祷告　神，不蒙着头是合宜的吗？
11.en: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

11.zh: 你们的本性不也指示你们，男人若有长头发，便是他的羞辱吗？
11.en: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

11.zh: 但女人有长头发，乃是她的荣耀，因为这头发是给她作盖头的。
11.en: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

11.zh: 若有人想要辩驳，我们却没有这样的规矩，　神的众教会也是没有的。
11.en: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

11.zh: 我现今吩咐你们的话，不是称赞你们；因为你们聚会不是受益，乃是招损。
11.en: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

11.zh: 第一，我听说，你们聚会的时候彼此分门别类，我也稍微地信这话。
11.en: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

11.zh: 在你们中间不免有分门结党的事，好叫那些有经验的人显明出来。
11.en: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

11.zh: 你们聚会的时候，算不得吃主的晚餐；
11.en: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

11.zh: 因为吃的时候，各人先吃自己的饭，甚至这个饥饿，那个酒醉。
11.en: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

11.zh: 你们要吃喝，难道没有家吗？还是藐视　神的教会，叫那没有的羞愧呢？我向你们可怎么说呢？可因此称赞你们吗？我不称赞！
11.en: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

11.zh: 我当日传给你们的，原是从主领受的，就是主耶稣被卖的那一夜，拿起饼来，
11.en: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

11.zh: 祝谢了，就擘开，说：「这是我的身体，为你们舍的，你们应当如此行，为的是记念我。」
11.en: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

11.zh: 饭后，也照样拿起杯来，说：「这杯是用我的血所立的新约，你们每逢喝的时候，要如此行，为的是记念我。」
11.en: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

11.zh: 你们每逢吃这饼，喝这杯，是表明主的死，直等到他来。
11.en: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

11.zh: 所以，无论何人，不按理吃主的饼，喝主的杯，就是干犯主的身、主的血了。
11.en: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

11.zh: 人应当自己省察，然后吃这饼、喝这杯。
11.en: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

11.zh: 因为人吃喝，若不分辨是[主的]身体，就是吃喝自己的罪了。
11.en: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

11.zh: 因此，在你们中间有好些软弱的与患病的，死的也不少。
11.en: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

11.zh: 我们若是先分辨自己，就不至于受审。
11.en: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

11.zh: 我们受审的时候，乃是被主惩治，免得我们和世人一同定罪。
11.en: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

11.zh: 所以我弟兄们，你们聚会吃的时候，要彼此等待。
11.en: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

11.zh: 若有人饥饿，可以在家里先吃，免得你们聚会，自己取罪。其余的事，我来的时候再安排。
11.en: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

12.zh: 弟兄们，论到属灵的[恩赐]，我不愿意你们不明白。
12.en: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

12.zh: 你们作外邦人的时候，随事被牵引，受迷惑，去服事那哑巴偶像，这是你们知道的。
12.en: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

12.zh: 所以我告诉你们，被　神的灵感动的，没有说「耶稣是可咒诅」的；若不是被[圣]灵感动的，也没有能说「耶稣是主」的。
12.en: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

12.zh: 恩赐原有分别，[圣]灵却是一位。
12.en: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

12.zh: 职事也有分别，主却是一位。
12.en: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

12.zh: 功用也有分别，　神却是一位，在众人里面运行一切的事。
12.en: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

12.zh: [圣]灵显在各人身上，是叫人得益处。
12.en: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

12.zh: 这人蒙[圣]灵赐他智慧的言语，那人也蒙这位[圣]灵赐他知识的言语，
12.en: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

12.zh: 又有一人蒙这位[圣]灵赐他信心，还有一人蒙这位[圣]灵赐他医病的恩赐，
12.en: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

12.zh: 又叫一人能行异能，又叫一人能作先知，又叫一人能辨别诸灵，又叫一人能说方言，又叫一人能翻方言。
12.en: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

12.zh: 这一切都是这位[圣]灵所运行、随己意分给各人的。
12.en: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

12.zh: 就如身子是一个，却有许多肢体；而且肢体虽多，仍是一个身子；基督也是这样。
12.en: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

12.zh: 我们不拘是犹太人，是希腊人，是为奴的，是自主的，都从一位[圣]灵受洗，成了一个身体，饮于一位[圣]灵。
12.en: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

12.zh: 身子原不是一个肢体，乃是许多肢体。
12.en: For the body is not one member, but many.

12.zh: 设若脚说：「我不是手，所以不属乎身子，」它不能因此就不属乎身子。
12.en: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

12.zh: 设若耳说：「我不是眼，所以不属乎身子，」它也不能因此就不属乎身子。
12.en: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

12.zh: 若全身是眼，从哪里听声呢？若全身是耳，从哪里闻味呢？
12.en: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

12.zh: 但如今，　神随自己的意思把肢体俱各安排在身上了。
12.en: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

12.zh: 若都是一个肢体，身子在哪里呢？
12.en: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

12.zh: 但如今肢体是多的，身子却是一个。
12.en: But now they are many members, but one body.

12.zh: 眼不能对手说：「我用不着你」；头也不能对脚说：「我用不着你。」
12.en: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

12.zh: 不但如此，身上肢体人以为软弱的，更是不可少的。
12.en: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

12.zh: 身上肢体，我们看为不体面的，越发给它加上体面；不俊美的，越发得着俊美。
12.en: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

12.zh: 我们俊美的肢体，自然用不着装饰；但　神配搭这身子，把加倍的体面给那有缺欠的肢体，
12.en: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

12.zh: 免得身上分门别类，总要肢体彼此相顾。
12.en: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

12.zh: 若一个肢体受苦，所有的肢体就一同受苦；若一个肢体得荣耀，所有的肢体就一同快乐。
12.en: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

12.zh: 你们就是基督的身子，并且各自作肢体。
12.en: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

12.zh: 神在教会所设立的：第一是使徒，第二是先知，第三是教师，其次是行异能的，再次是得恩赐医病的，帮助人的，治理事的，说方言的。
12.en: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

12.zh: 岂都是使徒吗？岂都是先知吗？岂都是教师吗？岂都是行异能的吗？
12.en: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

12.zh: 岂都是得恩赐医病的吗？岂都是说方言的吗？岂都是翻方言的吗？
12.en: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

12.zh: 你们要切切地求那更大的恩赐。 我现今把最妙的道指示你们。
12.en: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

13.zh: 我若能说万人的方言，并天使的话语，却没有爱，我就成了鸣的锣，响的钹一般。
13.en: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

13.zh: 我若有先知讲道[之能]，也明白各样的奥秘，各样的知识，而且有全备的信，叫我能够移山，却没有爱，我就算不得什么。
13.en: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

13.zh: 我若将所有的周济[穷人]，又舍己身叫人焚烧，却没有爱，仍然与我无益。
13.en: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

13.zh: 爱是恒久忍耐，又有恩慈；爱是不嫉妒；爱是不自夸，不张狂，
13.en: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

13.zh: 不做害羞的事，不求自己的益处，不轻易发怒，不计算[人的]恶，
13.en: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

13.zh: 不喜欢不义，只喜欢真理；
13.en: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

13.zh: 凡事包容，凡事相信，凡事盼望，凡事忍耐。
13.en: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

13.zh: 爱是永不止息。先知讲道之能终必归于无有；说方言之能终必停止；知识也终必归于无有。
13.en: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

13.zh: 我们现在所知道的有限，先知所讲的也有限，
13.en: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

13.zh: 等那完全的来到，这有限的必归于无有了。
13.en: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

13.zh: 我作孩子的时候，话语像孩子，心思像孩子，意念像孩子，既成了人，就把孩子的事丢弃了。
13.en: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

13.zh: 我们如今仿佛对着镜子观看，模糊不清，到那时就要面对面了。我如今所知道的有限，到那时就全知道，如同主知道我一样。
13.en: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

13.zh: 如今常存的有信，有望，有爱这三样，其中最大的是爱。
13.en: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

14.zh: 你们要追求爱，也要切慕属灵的[恩赐]，其中更要羡慕的，是作先知讲道。
14.en: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

14.zh: 那说方言的，原不是对人说，乃是对　神说，因为没有人听出来。然而，他在心灵里却是讲说各样的奥秘。
14.en: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

14.zh: 但作先知讲道的，是对人说，要造就、安慰、劝勉人。
14.en: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

14.zh: 说方言的，是造就自己；作先知讲道的，乃是造就教会。
14.en: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

14.zh: 我愿意你们都说方言，更愿意你们作先知讲道；因为说方言的，若不翻出来，使教会被造就，那作先知讲道的，就比他强了。
14.en: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

14.zh: 弟兄们，我到你们那里去，若只说方言，不用启示，或知识，或预言，或教训，给你们讲解，我与你们有什么益处呢？
14.en: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

14.zh: 就是那有声无气的物，或箫，或琴，若发出来的声音没有分别，怎能知道所吹所弹的是什么呢？
14.en: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

14.zh: 若吹无定的号声，谁能预备打仗呢？
14.en: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

14.zh: 你们也是如此。舌头若不说容易明白的话，怎能知道所说的是什么呢？这就是向空说话了。
14.en: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

14.zh: 世上的声音，或者甚多，却没有一样是无意思的。
14.en: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

14.zh: 我若不明白那声音的意思，这说话的人必以我为化外之人，我也以他为化外之人。
14.en: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

14.zh: 你们也是如此，既是切慕属灵的[恩赐]，就当求多得造就教会的恩赐。
14.en: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

14.zh: 所以那说方言的，就当求着能翻出来。
14.en: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

14.zh: 我若用方言祷告，是我的灵祷告，但我的悟性没有果效。
14.en: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

14.zh: 这却怎么样呢？我要用灵祷告，也要用悟性祷告；我要用灵歌唱，也要用悟性歌唱。
14.en: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

14.zh: 不然，你用灵祝谢，那在座不通方言的人，既然不明白你的话，怎能在你感谢的时候说「阿们」呢？
14.en: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

14.zh: 你感谢的固然是好，无奈不能造就别人。
14.en: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

14.zh: 我感谢　神，我说方言比你们众人还多。
14.en: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

14.zh: 但在教会中，宁可用悟性说五句教导人的话，强如说万句方言。
14.en: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

14.zh: 弟兄们，在心志上不要作小孩子。然而，在恶事上要作婴孩，在心志上总要作大人。
14.en: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

14.zh: 律法上记着： 主说：我要用外邦人的舌头 和外邦人的嘴唇向这百姓说话； 虽然如此， 他们还是不听从我。
14.en: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”

14.zh: 这样看来，说方言不是为信的人作证据，乃是为不信的人；作先知讲道不是为不信的人[作证据]，乃是为信的人。
14.en: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

14.zh: 所以，全教会聚在一处的时候，若都说方言，偶然有不通方言的，或是不信的人进来，岂不说你们癫狂了吗？
14.en: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

14.zh: 若都作先知讲道，偶然有不信的，或是不通方言的人进来，就被众人劝醒，被众人审明，
14.en: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

14.zh: 他心里的隐情显露出来，就必将脸伏地，敬拜　神，说：「　神真是在你们中间了。」
14.en: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

14.zh: 弟兄们，这却怎么样呢？你们聚会的时候，各人或有诗歌，或有教训，或有启示，或有方言，或有翻出来的话，凡事都当造就人。
14.en: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

14.zh: 若有说方言的，只好两个人，至多三个人，且要轮流着说，也要一个人翻出来。
14.en: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

14.zh: 若没有人翻，就当在会中闭口，只对自己和　神说就是了。
14.en: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

14.zh: 至于作先知讲道的，只好两个人或是三个人，其余的就当[慎思]明辨。
14.en: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

14.zh: 若旁边坐着的得了启示，那先说话的就当闭口不言。
14.en: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

14.zh: 因为你们都可以一个一个地作先知讲道，叫众人学道理，叫众人得劝勉。
14.en: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

14.zh: 先知的灵原是顺服先知的；
14.en: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

14.zh: 因为　神不是叫人混乱，乃是叫人安静。
14.en: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

14.zh: 妇女在会中要闭口不言，像在圣徒的众教会一样，因为不准她们说话。她们总要顺服，正如律法所说的。
14.en: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

14.zh: 她们若要学什么，可以在家里问自己的丈夫，因为妇女在会中说话原是可耻的。
14.en: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

14.zh: 神的道理岂是从你们出来吗？岂是单临到你们吗？
14.en: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

14.zh: 若有人以为自己是先知，或是属灵的，就该知道，我所写给你们的是主的命令。
14.en: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

14.zh: 若有不知道的，就由他不知道吧！
14.en: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

14.zh: 所以我弟兄们，你们要切慕作先知讲道，也不要禁止说方言。
14.en: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

14.zh: 凡事都要规规矩矩地按着次序行。
14.en: Let all things be done decently and in order.

15.zh: 弟兄们，我如今把先前所传给你们的福音告诉你们知道；这福音你们也领受了，又靠着站立得住，
15.en: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

15.zh: 并且你们若不是徒然相信，能以持守我所传给你们的，就必因这福音得救。
15.en: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

15.zh: 我当日所领受又传给你们的：第一，就是基督照圣经所说，为我们的罪死了，
15.en: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

15.zh: 而且埋葬了；又照圣经所说，第三天复活了，
15.en: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

15.zh: 并且显给矶法看，然后显给十二使徒看；
15.en: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

15.zh: 后来一时显给五百多弟兄看，其中一大半到如今还在，却也有已经睡了的。
15.en: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

15.zh: 以后显给雅各看，再显给众使徒看，
15.en: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

15.zh: 末了也显给我看；我如同未到产期而生的人一般。
15.en: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

15.zh: 我原是使徒中最小的，不配称为使徒，因为我从前逼迫　神的教会。
15.en: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

15.zh: 然而，我今日成了何等人，是蒙　神的恩才成的，并且他所赐我的恩不是徒然的。我比众使徒格外劳苦；这原不是我，乃是　神的恩与我同在。
15.en: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

15.zh: 不拘是我，是众使徒，我们如此传，你们也如此信了。
15.en: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

15.zh: 既传基督是从死里复活了，怎么在你们中间有人说没有死人复活的事呢？
15.en: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

15.zh: 若没有死人复活的事，基督也就没有复活了。
15.en: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

15.zh: 若基督没有复活，我们所传的便是枉然，你们所信的也是枉然；
15.en: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

15.zh: 并且明显我们是为　神妄作见证的，因我们见证　神是叫基督复活了。若死人真不复活，　神也就没有叫基督复活了。
15.en: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

15.zh: 因为死人若不复活，基督也就没有复活了。
15.en: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

15.zh: 基督若没有复活，你们的信便是徒然，你们仍在罪里。
15.en: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

15.zh: 就是在基督里睡了的人也灭亡了。
15.en: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

15.zh: 我们若靠基督只在今生有指望，就算比众人更可怜。
15.en: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

15.zh: 但基督已经从死里复活，成为睡了之人初熟的果子。
15.en: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

15.zh: 死既是因一人而来，死人复活也是因一人而来。
15.en: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

15.zh: 在亚当里众人都死了；照样，在基督里众人也都要复活。
15.en: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

15.zh: 但各人是按着自己的次序复活：初熟的果子是基督；以后，在他来的时候，是那些属基督的。
15.en: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

15.zh: 再后，末期到了，那时基督既将一切执政的、掌权的、有能的都毁灭了，就把国交与父　神。
15.en: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

15.zh: 因为基督必要作王，等　神把一切仇敌都放在他的脚下。
15.en: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

15.zh: 尽末了所毁灭的仇敌就是死。
15.en: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

15.zh: 因为[经上]说：「　神叫万物都服在他的脚下。」既说万物都服了他，明显那叫万物服他的，不在其内了。
15.en: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

15.zh: 万物既服了他，那时子也要自己服那叫万物服他的，叫　神在万物之上，为万物之主。
15.en: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

15.zh: 不然，那些为死人受洗的，将来怎样呢？若死人总不复活，因何为他们受洗呢？
15.en: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

15.zh: 我们又因何时刻冒险呢？
15.en: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

15.zh: 弟兄们，我在我主基督耶稣里，指着你们所夸的口极力地说，我是天天[冒]死。
15.en: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

15.zh: 我若当日像寻常人，在以弗所同野兽战斗，那于我有什么益处呢？若死人不复活， 我们就吃吃喝喝吧！ 因为明天要死了。
15.en: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

15.zh: 你们不要自欺；滥交是败坏善行。
15.en: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

15.zh: 你们要醒悟为善，不要犯罪，因为有人不认识　神。我说这话是要叫你们羞愧。
15.en: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

15.zh: 或有人问：「死人怎样复活，带着什么身体来呢？」
15.en: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

15.zh: 无知的人哪，你所种的，若不死就不能生。
15.en: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

15.zh: 并且你所种的不是那将来的形体，不过是子粒，即如麦子，或是别样的谷。
15.en: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

15.zh: 但　神随自己的意思给他一个形体，并叫各等子粒各有自己的形体。
15.en: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

15.zh: 凡肉体各有不同：人是一样，兽又是一样，鸟又是一样，鱼又是一样。
15.en: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

15.zh: 有天上的形体，也有地上的形体；但天上形体的荣光是一样，地上形体的荣光又是一样。
15.en: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

15.zh: 日有日的荣光，月有月的荣光，星有星的荣光；这星和那星的荣光也有分别。
15.en: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

15.zh: 死人复活也是这样：所种的是必朽坏的，复活的是不朽坏的；
15.en: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

15.zh: 所种的是羞辱的，复活的是荣耀的；所种的是软弱的，复活的是强壮的；
15.en: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

15.zh: 所种的是血气的身体，复活的是灵性的身体。若有血气的身体，也必有灵性的身体。
15.en: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

15.zh: [经上]也是这样记着说：「首先的人亚当成了有灵的活人」；末后的亚当成了叫人活的灵。
15.en: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

15.zh: 但属灵的不在先，属血气的在先，以后才有属灵的。
15.en: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

15.zh: 头一个人是出于地，乃属土；第二个人是出于天。
15.en: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

15.zh: 那属土的怎样，凡属土的也就怎样；属天的怎样，凡属天的也就怎样。
15.en: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

15.zh: 我们既有属土的形状，将来也必有属天的形状。
15.en: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

15.zh: 弟兄们，我告诉你们说，血肉[之体]不能承受　神的国，必朽坏的不能承受不朽坏的。
15.en: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

15.zh: 我如今把一件奥秘的事告诉你们：我们不是都要睡觉，乃是都要改变，
15.en: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

15.zh: 就在一霎时，眨眼之间，号筒末次吹响的时候。因号筒要响，死人要复活成为不朽坏的，我们也要改变。
15.en: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

15.zh: 这必朽坏的总要变成不朽坏的，这必死的总要变成不死的。
15.en: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

15.zh: 这必朽坏的既变成不朽坏的，这必死的既变成不死的，那时[经上]所记「死被得胜吞灭」的话就应验了。
15.en: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

15.zh: 死啊！你得胜的权势在哪里？ 死啊！你的毒钩在哪里？
15.en: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

15.zh: 死的毒钩就是罪，罪的权势就是律法。
15.en: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

15.zh: 感谢　神，使我们借着我们的主耶稣基督得胜。
15.en: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

15.zh: 所以，我亲爱的弟兄们，你们务要坚固，不可摇动，常常竭力多做主工；因为知道，你们的劳苦在主里面不是徒然的。
15.en: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

16.zh: 论到为圣徒捐钱，我从前怎样吩咐加拉太的众教会，你们也当怎样行。
16.en: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

16.zh: 每逢七日的第一日，各人要照自己的进项抽出来留着，免得我来的时候现凑。
16.en: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

16.zh: 及至我来到了，你们写信举荐谁，我就打发他们，把你们的捐资送到耶路撒冷去。
16.en: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

16.zh: 若我也该去，他们可以和我同去。
16.en: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

16.zh: 我要从马其顿经过；既经过了，就要到你们那里去，
16.en: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

16.zh: 或者和你们同住几时，或者也过冬。无论我往哪里去，你们就可以给我送行。
16.en: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

16.zh: 我如今不愿意路过见你们；主若许我，我就指望和你们同住几时。
16.en: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

16.zh: 但我要仍旧住在以弗所，直等到五旬节；
16.en: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

16.zh: 因为有宽大又有功效的门为我开了，并且反对的人也多。
16.en: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

16.zh: 若是提摩太来到，你们要留心，叫他在你们那里无所惧怕；因为他劳力做主的工，像我一样。
16.en: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

16.zh: 所以，无论谁都不可藐视他，只要送他平安前行，叫他到我这里来，因我指望他和弟兄们同来。
16.en: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

16.zh: 至于兄弟亚波罗，我再三地劝他同弟兄们到你们那里去；但这时他决不愿意去，几时有了机会他必去。
16.en: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

16.zh: 你们务要警醒，在真道上站立得稳，要作大丈夫，要刚强。
16.en: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

16.zh: 凡你们所做的都要凭爱心而做。
16.en: Let all that you do be done in love.

16.zh: 弟兄们，你们晓得司提反一家，是亚该亚初结的果子，并且他们专以服事圣徒为念。
16.en: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

16.zh: 我劝你们顺服这样的人，并一切同工同劳的人。
16.en: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

16.zh: 司提反和福徒拿都，并亚该古到这里来，我很喜欢；因为你们待我有不及之处，他们补上了。
16.en: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

16.zh: 他们叫我和你们心里都快活。这样的人，你们务要敬重。
16.en: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

16.zh: 亚细亚的众教会问你们安。亚居拉和百基拉并在他们家里的教会，因主多多地问你们安。
16.en: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

16.zh: 众弟兄都问你们安。你们要亲嘴问安，彼此务要圣洁。
16.en: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

16.zh: 我—保罗亲笔问安。
16.en: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

16.zh: 若有人不爱主，这人可诅可咒。主必要来！
16.en: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

16.zh: 愿主耶稣基督的恩[常]与你们众人同在！
16.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

16.zh: 我在基督耶稣里的爱与你们众人同在。阿们！
16.en: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
